title: A coke chain needs starter fuel and a consumer reserve
claim: Concurrent metal production exhausted the fuel supply. The lignite-to-coke maintenance order also required four fuel bars before activation, preventing it from restarting at low stock. One finite charcoal job supplied starter fuel; lowering the coke input gate and reserving more fuel for consumers was followed by renewed coke production.
reproduction: Inspect exact coke reaction inputs, active jobs and all competing fuel consumers. In a disposable backed-up game, retain a starter-fuel path, adjust conditions to the loaded recipe, and verify actual coke output before resuming high-volume ore or equipment work.
evidence: Firsthand AI-assisted Namemerchants observations on 2026-11-02; sanitized summaries of native state, not a published save or raw telemetry.
The observed order changed from a four-bar starter gate to one; its batch size increased from two to four.
A single charcoal job completed; native free coke subsequently rose from zero to 27 bars.
limitations: One live fortress on Windows; relevant mods were not fully inventoried. Community reproduction is pending. The particular thresholds were local policy, not universal safe values. A condition is not a reservation: several already-active jobs can still consume the same reserve.
